QuestInfo.name: Love Spreader
QuestInfo.0: The Ace of Hearts wishes to give you a gift for helping out everyone for Valentine's Day.\n
QuestInfo.1: Chief Stan wishes to give you a gift for helping out everyone for Valentine's Day.\n
QuestInfo.2: You received a buff item for helping out Gaga, Cassandra, Inkwell, and the Maple Administrator.\n

0.0: Everyone is so busy trying to prepare a gift for their crushes on Valentine's Day! I saw what you did for them, and figured you deserved something for yourself, you little Cupid.

yes.0: Here, take this Valentine's Day Buff! I'll keep on giving it to you each time you help everyone that needs it. Happy Valentine's Day!

no.0: Giving up on the Maple Awards already? Well, let me know if you decide fame IS for you, after all.

item.0: Remember, I need 30 Shiny Light Bulbs.
